description: UK area profile for a postcode or postcode district (e.g. SW1A): local authorities, wards and constituencies, plus street-level crime in the latest published month within about a mile, counted by category and outcome. Official ONS and police data (OGL). Price: $0.01 in USDC per call (x402 or prepaid credits). In the free trial.
